shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "cat AGENTS.md && cat .lore/test-commands.yml && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts && sed -n '1,150p' src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,100p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,80p' CHANGELOG.md && cat package.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,120p' src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts; sed -n '1,110p' src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts; sed -n '1,40p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; sed -n '1,24p' CHANGELOG.md; rg -n 'test-commands|spec-anchor|spec:' .lore/test-commands.yml"
/bin/zsh -lc "command -v lore-query-trace || true; sed -n '16,24p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; git status --short"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'called with session and error|error still propagates after onError hook|error path calls onError then afterSession|spec: specs/hal-engine-config-hooks' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; rg -n 'reanchor' scripts; git branch --show-current; git status -sb; git remote -v"
/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 npm test -- --runInBand src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts -t 'passes a rejected Error instance to onError unchanged'"

/bin/zsh -lc "command -v gtimeout; command -v node; command -v npm; node -e \"const {spawn}=require('node:child_process'); const child=spawn('npm',['test','--','--runInBand','src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts','-t','passes a rejected Error instance to onError unchanged'],{stdio:'inherit'}); const timer=setTimeout(()=>{child.kill('SIGTERM'); process.exitCode=124;},300000); child.on('exit',(code,signal)=>{clearTimeout(timer); if(signal==='SIGTERM') process.exitCode=124; else process.exitCode=code??1;});\""

/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && rg -n \"it\\('wraps|it\\('passes a rejected|it\\('calls onError with|it\\('calls onError with a readable\" src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md"
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n '// spec: specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md' src | head -20; rg -n 'spec: ' src/orchestration | head -25; sed -n '1,120p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs"

/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && rg -n \"it\\('wraps|it\\('passes a rejected|it\\('calls onError with|it\\('calls onError with a readable\" src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && git diff --check && git status --short"

/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "fix(orchestrator): complete onError rejection handling"'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
